readback.title: Retire eleven false owner aliases found in the Step 7d hydrate review
readback.body:
Observed during the full current-owner Step 7d review for #901 at main `467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1`. These are proposed corrections or explicit deferrals before source writes; structural validation is not scientific approval. Exact owner preimages, primary-source capture hashes and full rubrics are prepared under `reports/step7d_mapping_901_20261103/` for the implementation PR.

Eleven active YAML synonym assertions do not name the complete owner substance. Ten are names of a water-free parent; the carbonate token is a preparation instruction. Six were identified in the author proposals and five by independent finding `step7d-independent-001`. [supplier-C6143](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/sigma/c6143); [sigma-deposit-C6143](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sourceid/Sigma-Aldrich/C6143_SIGMA/JSON) |

Retain the synonym text and its source as provenance; change only its type and append the curation history/evidence. Regenerate through the native builder and verify none of these tokens is exported in the affected `other` payloads while unrelated synonyms and all 23 deferred pairs remain unchanged. Tokens already filtered upstream do not justify an invented TSV change. Do not infer a fixed hydrate from a display structure.

Deduplication: #669 owns the broader cross-record preferred-name policy; this exact false-form/source-instruction batch is outside its deferred pairs. Closed #606 addressed the general parenthetical filter; the carbonate YAML source assertion remains to be retagged. #718 remains the umbrella for withheld claims. This issue records the bounded eleven source corrections, not a new alias-selection rule.

Use exact-preimage guarded writers, preserve every historical event and raw source string, synchronize individual/aggregate records and native SSSOM, and append a real timestamped LLM-assisted curation event. Regeneration must be reviewed, pass `just qc` and the full suite, and receive independent final-head review. No role approval, owner merge or unrelated source change is authorized.

readback.title: Correct four hydrate parent scopes before the Step 7d relation migration
readback.body:
Observed during the full current-owner Step 7d review for #901 at main `467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1`. These are proposed corrections or explicit deferrals before source writes; structural validation is not scientific approval. Exact owner preimages, primary-source capture hashes and full rubrics are prepared under `reports/step7d_mapping_901_20261103/` for the implementation PR.

Four existing hydrate owners have a closer chemically supported ontology parent than the one currently recorded. Keep each distinct hydrate identity and use `NARROW_MATCH`, which exports `skos:broadMatch` under the current MAPPING_SEMANTICS §3/#390 convention. None is an exact hydrate-to-parent assertion.

| Owner | Current parent → proposed parent | Evidence and boundary |
|---|---|---|
| [`Beta-Glycerophosphate_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Beta-Glycerophosphate_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate.yaml) | [CHEBI:17270](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/17270/) → [CHEBI:132089](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/132089/) | Keep the source CAS 154804-51-0 hydrate. The nearer parent includes the two sodium ions; do not select the distinct fixed-water sibling CHEBI:132092 or merge the existing dry-salt owner. [supplier-G9422](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/sigma/g9422); [sigma-deposit-G9422-sigma](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sourceid/Sigma-Aldrich/G9422_SIGMA/JSON) |
| [`D-Glucuronic_Acid_Sodium_Salt_Monohydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/D-Glucuronic_Acid_Sodium_Salt_Monohydrate.yaml) | [CHEBI:4178](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/4178/) → [CHEBI:32144](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/32144/) | Source CAS 207300-70-7 and PubChem CID 24892836 describe the sodium salt monohydrate. CHEBI:32144 preserves the D stereochemistry and sodium salt; the present parent is the free acid. [v1:25-pubchem-cas](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/207300-70-7/property/MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,IUPACName/JSON); [v1:25-chebi-parent](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/4178/) |
| [`EDTA_Tetrasodium_Tetrahydrate_Salt`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/EDTA_Tetrasodium_Tetrahydrate_Salt.yaml) | [CHEBI:4735](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/4735/) → [CHEBI:750784](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/750784/) | Source CAS 13235-36-4/FW 452.23 and PubChem CID 23287279 describe four sodium ions and four waters. CHEBI:750784 preserves the tetrasodium parent; CHEBI:4735 is EDTA free acid. [v1:30-pubchem-cas](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/13235-36-4/property/MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,IUPACName/JSON); [v7:30-ncit-edetate-sodium](https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/C76598?include=full) |
| [`Maltotriose_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Maltotriose_Hydrate.yaml) | [CHEBI:61993](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/61993/) → [CHEBI:140999](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/140999/) | Source CAS 312693-63-3 and PubChem CID 16218586 support cyclic maltotriose with unspecified reducing-end anomer. CHEBI:61993 is explicitly aldehydo/open-chain; CHEBI:140999 matches the cyclic parent scope without selecting an alpha reducing end. [Maltotriose_Hydrate--pubchem-cas](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/312693-63-3/JSON); [Maltotriose_Hydrate--chebi-parent](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/61993/) |

Update the parent CURIE, its exact canonical label, the mapping grade and source-bound evidence together. Preserve own identifiers, occurrence ownership, historic evidence and role holds; native regeneration must retain the required exact identity/registry rows. Withdraw incompatible whole-material chemistry only where separately documented on #268.

Deduplication: #901 owns the relation migration. Closed #239 concerned missing parent/registry rows, not these four current parent-scope corrections. Closed #1020 concerns the separate `Na2glycerophosphate5h2o` owner and its positional-isomer correction; neither it nor open #1053 licenses reassigning the distinct records here. Open #777 names four unrelated CAS primaries.

readback.title: Resolve thirteen catalogue and registry identity decisions deferred from Step 7d
readback.body:
Observed during the full current-owner Step 7d review for #901 at main `467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1`. These are proposed corrections or explicit deferrals before source writes; structural validation is not scientific approval. Exact owner preimages, primary-source capture hashes and full rubrics are prepared under `reports/step7d_mapping_901_20261103/` for the implementation PR.

These **13 owners are dropped in full** from Step 7d. Each needs a source-material, registry-scope or ontology decision before even a relation-only update is safe. Source records, chemistry, memberships and mapping holds remain unchanged.

| Owner | Observed conflict and primary evidence | Options to resolve | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`A-Ketoglutaric_Acid_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/A-Ketoglutaric_Acid_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate.yaml) | Sigma K3752 uses variable-water hydrate wording and CAS 305-72-6, also used for the dry disodium compound. [supplier-K3752](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/sial/k3752); [sigma-sid-K3752](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sid/329817140/JSON); [pubchem-cas-305-72-6](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/305-72-6/property/Title,MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,CanonicalSMILES/JSON) | Decide whether the source CAS is a defensible identity for the complete commercial hydrate, or whether a distinct local supplied-form owner is required. | Obtain the source specification and record the CAS-versus-supplied-form ruling; retain this owner unchanged meanwhile. |
| [`Adenine_Hydrochloride_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Adenine_Hydrochloride_Hydrate.yaml) | A8751 specifies C5H5N5·HCl·xH2O, while CAS 2922-28-3/PubChem 76219 denotes water-free hydrochloride. [supplier-A8751](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/sigma/a8751); [sigma-deposit-A8751](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sourceid/Sigma-Aldrich/A8751_SIGMA/JSON); [pubchem-cas-2922-28-3](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/2922-28-3/property/Title,MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,CanonicalSMILES/JSON) | Establish whether the CAS concept includes the commercial hydrate, or retain a separately identified hydrate material. | Do not mint or promote by inference; obtain the original specification and make the owner-boundary decision. |
| [`Bathophenanthrolinedisulfonic_Acid_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Bathophenanthrolinedisulfonic_Acid_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate.yaml) | Historical catalogue 146617 is a trihydrate, but candidate CHEBI:234116 places sulfonates at phenanthroline 3,8, whereas current CHEBI:78157 represents phenyl 4′,4″ positions. [supplier-146617](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/aldrich/146617); [chebi-78157](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/78157/); [chebi-232316](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/232316/); [CHEBI:234116 candidate](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/234116/) | Verify the actual supplied positional isomer, then select its form-specific term or distinct registry identity; alternatively document that the catalogue/label association is wrong. | Resolve positional structure from the original specification. Label and formula agreement alone cannot choose the candidate. |
| [`Ceftazidime_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Ceftazidime_Hydrate.yaml) | Historical C3809 is a stabilized ceftazidime hydrate preparation with sodium carbonate. [sigma-deposit-C3809](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sourceid/Sigma-Aldrich/C3809_SIGMA/JSON); [pubchem-cas-120618-65-7](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/120618-65-7/property/Title,MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,CanonicalSMILES/JSON); [chebi-3508](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/3508/) | Decide whether this owner denotes the active hydrate or the complete stabilized product; the latter needs preparation/component representation based on source evidence. | Obtain the historical product composition and retain the whole owner unchanged; do not guess hydration or remove carbonate from the product concept. |
| [`CrKSO42_X_12_H2O`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/CrKSO42_X_12_H2O.yaml) | CAS 7788-99-0 supports potassium chromium sulfate dodecahydrate. Current CHEBI:53471 chromium(III) sulfate omits potassium and has different sulfate stoichiometry. [pubchem-cas-7788-99-0](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/7788-99-0/property/Title,MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,CanonicalSMILES/JSON); [chebi-53471](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/53471/) | Identify an exact whole double-salt term or justify the appropriate whole-material parent relationship; a chromium sulfate-only hydrate relation is insufficient. | Keep the existing local owner and hold pending an explicit double-salt grounding decision; do not invent component assertions. |

[web:I1252](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/sigma/i1252); [v1:29-pubchem-cas](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/1637-73-6/property/MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,IUPACName/JSON); [v1:29-chebi-parent](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/172950/) | Determine whether the registry/ontology concept genuinely includes the supplied hydrate or only its dry parent. | Preserve the local hydrate owner; do not promote merely because the supplier repeats the same CAS. |

NCIT:C223823 defines sodium fosmidomycin at 205.08; supplier F8682 instead uses variable sodium/water, CAS 66508-53-0 and free-acid-basis 183.10. [web:F8682](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/sigma/f8682); [v1:33-pubchem-cas](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/66508-37-0/property/MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,IUPACName/JSON); [prior:ncit-C223823-fosmidomycin-sodium](https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/C223823?include=full) | Recover the actual supplier/material to distinguish a fixed monosodium compound from a variable sodium hydrate; correct a source transcription only with evidence. | Do not assign F8682 to a catalogue row with no supplier or promote to NCIt solely by CAS overlap. |
